Class KonceptBadgeAnatomyBlockMacro

@Name("koncept-badge-anatomy") public class KonceptBadgeAnatomyBlockMacro extends org.asciidoctor.extension.BlockMacroProcessor
AsciidoctorJ block macro that renders the anatomy of a Koncept Badge as a real, captioned figure: the referenced koncept's badge — kind sigil, identicon, name — drawn large, with a muted part label beneath each part.

Usage in AsciiDoc, per the image standards (block title and alt text always present): 

.Anatomy of a Koncept Badge
koncept-badge-anatomy::DescriptionPattern[]

The figure is composed at conversion time by KonceptFigureRenderer from the same primitives the badges render with — the KonceptKind sigil glyph/colour data and the IdenticonRenderer LifeHash image — so the illustration can never drift from a real badge. The target resolves through KonceptResolver exactly as a k: reference does; a target with no computable identity renders a visible placeholder. The html family embeds a data: URI; file-referencing backends get a content-addressed PNG file. Drawn at 2× and displayed at half width for crispness.

An uncurated typed target — a component whose identity is source-declared but not in koncepts.yml, like a ledger-declared STAMP whose PublicId is the deterministic Stamp.stampUuid of its tuple — resolves with no kind and its id as label, so the author asserts both explicitly: 

.Anatomy of a STAMP badge
koncept-badge-anatomy::uuid=1e041b79-…[kind=stamp, label="Active · 2026-07-12 00:00 · IKE Community"]
The same adopt-never-re-mint discipline as declared component identities: assert only what the source of the identity declares. A stamp anatomy renders the pentagon on the gray provenance chip, with the verbatim provenance text labelled provenance in place of name.
